claims.text: Not having access to pre-trained embeddings would likely result in lower performance in sequence tagging tasks, as demonstrated by the significant drop in performance when task-specific RNNs were removed.
The inclusion of LM embeddings improved performance from 90.87% to 91.93% F1, indicating that without them, the model would perform worse than the baseline.
Pre-trained embeddings are essential for achieving state-of-the-art results in NLP tasks, and their absence would hinder the model's ability to capture context-sensitive representations.
